title: Patio Renovation and Sun Sail Installation
agency: TREASURY, DEPARTMENT OF THE > BUREAU OF ENGRAVING AND PRINTING > OFFICE OF THE CHIEF PROCUREMENT OFFICER
description:
Sources Sought Notice – Post 15 Entry Plaza Refurbishment Project 

 The Bureau of Engraving and Printing (BEP) is conducting market research to identify qualified small business contractors capable of performing the Post 15 Entry Plaza Refurbishment Project at the Western Currency Facility (WCF), located at 9000 Blue Mound Road, Fort Worth, TX 76131. 

 The anticipated scope of work includes demolition and replacement of existing concrete and tile surfaces, site preparation, grading and drainage improvements, irrigation work, and installation of sun sail shade structures. The contractor will be responsible for providing all necessary labor, materials, equipment, supervision, and related services to complete the project. 

  Interested contractors should submit the following information:  

 
	 
	 Company name, address, Unique Entity ID (UEI), and point of contact. 
	 
	 
	 Business size and socioeconomic status (e.g., Small Business, SDVOSB, HUBZone, WOSB, or 8(a)). 
	 
	 
	 A brief capabilities statement demonstrating experience with similar construction or renovation projects. 
	 
	 
	 Examples of relevant projects completed within the past five years. 
	 
 

  Responses Due:  04 December 2026 

 Responses shall be submitted via email to ariel.dillon@bep.gov. 

  This notice is for market research purposes only and is not a solicitation or request for proposals.  No contract award will be made as a result of this notice. The Government will not reimburse respondents for costs incurred in preparing responses. 

 Information received will assist BEP in determining the appropriate acquisition strategy for this requirement.
